=IDX={{ $('Loop Main').item.json.index }}; GRAIN={{ $('Randomization').first().json.grainIntensity }}; test -n "$IDX"; DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=nk=1:nw=1 /tmp/video_tmp/voice_${IDX}.m4a 2>/dev/null | cut -d. -f1); [ -z "$DUR" ] && DUR=8; [ "$DUR" -lt 2 ] && DUR=8; [ "$DUR" -gt 90 ] && DUR=90; if [ -s /tmp/video_tmp/scene_${IDX}.mp4 ]; then ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -stream_loop -1 -i /tmp/video_tmp/scene_${IDX}.mp4 -i /tmp/video_tmp/voice_${IDX}.m4a -vf "scale=1280:720:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1280:720,fps=24,noise=alls=${GRAIN}:allf=t" -t "$DUR" -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -tune stillimage -crf 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 44100 -ac 2 /tmp/video_tmp/scene_${IDX}_out.mp4; else test -s /tmp/video_tmp/scene_${IDX}.png; ffmpeg -y -threads 1 -loop 1 -i /tmp/video_tmp/scene_${IDX}.png -i /tmp/video_tmp/voice_${IDX}.m4a -vf "scale=1280:720:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1280:720,fps=24,noise=alls=${GRAIN}:allf=t" -t "$DUR" -map 0:v:0 -map 1:a:0 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -tune stillimage -crf 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -ar 44100 -ac 2 /tmp/video_tmp/scene_${IDX}_out.mp4; fi && test -s /tmp/video_tmp/scene_${IDX}_out.mp4 && ls -lh /tmp/video_tmp/scene_${IDX}_out.mp4 && echo SCENE_OK_${IDX}

=python3 << 'EOF'
import json, base64, urllib.request, os, sys, urllib.parse, subprocess

API_KEY = "{{$env.GEMINI_API_KEY}}"

title = """{{ $('Parse Main').first().json.youtube_title.replace(/"/g, '') }}"""
prompt_extra = """{{ ($('Parse Main').first().json.thumbnail_prompt || '').replace(/"/g, '') }}"""

prompt = f"""Generate a viral YouTube thumbnail image, 16:9.
Style: Simple History / Ink Explainer educational doodle.
- Huge exaggerated facial expression (shock, disgust, or fear).
- One main character only, big in frame.
- High contrast black ink line art on white background.
- Leave a clean area on the left for title text (DO NOT DRAW TEXT).
Video context: {title}. Visual Idea: {prompt_extra}"""

def run_fallback():
    print("Using Pollinations Fallback...")
    q = urllib.parse.quote(prompt_extra[:200] + ", Simple History style YouTube thumbnail, high contrast ink doodle, huge expressive face, white background")
    subprocess.check_call(["curl","-sL","--max-time","120","-o","/home/node/.n8n-files/thumbnail.png", f"https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{q}?width=1920&height=1080&model=flux&nologo=true"])
    sys.exit(0)

if API_KEY == "PASTE_YOUR_GEMINI_KEY_HERE" or API_KEY == "":
    run_fallback()

url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-1.5-pro:generateContent?key={API_KEY}"
body = {
  "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
  "generationConfig": {"responseModalities": ["TEXT", "IMAGE"]}
}
req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})

try:
    resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90)
    data = json.load(resp)
    parts = data["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"]
    img_b64 = None
    for p in parts:
        inline = p.get("inlineData") or p.get("inline_data")
        if inline and inline.get("data"):
            img_b64 = inline["data"]
            break
    if img_b64:
        open("/home/node/.n8n-files/thumbnail.png","wb").write(base64.b64decode(img_b64))
        print("GEMINI_THUMB_OK")
    else:
        run_fallback()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Gemini failed: {e}")
    run_fallback()
EOF
